pages.text: $(bold)$(li)Sleeping in the same bed makes it a $(thing)home bed$(n), which gives more back each night.$(br)$(li)Hammocks for a camp: $(l:paths/furnishings)Furnishings$(n), ring 3.$(br)$(li)Night bag for the road: $(l:paths/dreaming)Dreaming$(n), ring 9.
pages.title: A1. Beds & Sleep
Infested Beds
pages.text: $(bold)$(#8A3B2F)Mansion beds are often infested.$(n) Sleep in one and bedbugs wake you.$(br2)$(li)Break it and make another; you lose what that bed had become.$(br)$(li)Or throw a $(thing)splash potion of Harming$(n) at it. Needs $(l:paths/brewing)Brewing$(n), ring 9.
